Container.Name: folderframe
Container.Overview: FolderFrame is a folder-based photo and video gallery with album browsing and slideshows, served by Caddy. Select a dedicated media folder; it is mounted read-only. Anyone who can reach the WebUI can download its media. No authentication or TLS is configured. Use on a trusted LAN, or add access controls before public exposure. Do not select an entire share, source repository, private files, or a folder containing symlinks.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Choose an unused host port for the gallery.

Config.Name: Media Folder
Config.Description: Select an existing dedicated gallery folder. Read-only does not prevent downloads. Do not select a whole share or repository.
